items.title: The higher derived lower shriek of an abelian sheaf along a morphism of fibred categories is computed by the homology of the index category
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the higher derived lower shriek L_n g_!F' along a morphism of fibred categories as the sheaf associated to U |-> H_n(I_U, F'_U) (statement lines 10677-10687). The proof (proof lines 10689-10732) introduces the index category of pairs (U', phi) over the fibre category, ameliorates the morphism to split off an exact piece, and reduces to the known computation lemma for the fibred case, identifying the index categories at the end. H2: one reduction through an ameliorated morphism plus one identification, written out.
